purpose: One-read asset-disjoint transfer of a causal post-capitulation rebound rule selected before downloading or evaluating the holdout assets.

source.integrity: Every archive file must pass the provider CHECKSUM before it enters a gzip bundle.

causality.threshold_fit: Each fold fits feature quantiles only on observations whose 24h targets matured before that fold began.
causality.overlap_control: At most one signal per asset is counted until the previous 24h forecast matures.
causality.market_block_control: Signals are also collapsed into UTC-day market blocks.
causality.episode_control: Market blocks separated by no more than 48h are merged into one episode.
causality.holdout_policy: The assets, rule, folds, direction, and gates cannot change after this file is committed. A failed result remains reported.
